The '''2027 MI Cape Town season''' is the fifth season of the franchise in the [[SA20]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=SA20 Season 5 SCHEDULE is here Mark your calendars, Kaapstad |url=https://micapetown.co.za/news/sa-20-season-5-schedule-is-here-mark-your-calendars-kaapstad |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=MI Cape Town}}</ref> The team is captained by [[Rashid Khan]] and coached by [[Robin Peterson]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/mumbai-indians-kieron-pollard-to-lead-mi-emirates-in-ilt20-rashid-khan-in-charge-of-mi-cape-town-in-sa20-league-1347781|title=Pollard to lead MI Emirates, Rashid put in charge of MI Cape Town|access-date=9 September 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/mi-cape-town-appoint-peterson-as-head-coach-and-malinga-as-bowling-coach-1400178|title=MI Cape Town appoint Robin Peterson as head coach and Lasith Malinga as bowling coach|access-date=9 September 2026|work=Cricinfo}}</ref>
